import copy, json
from work import evaluate
policy={'edges':{'plain>done':{},'secure>done':{'role':'admin'},'retry>done':{'retry':True},'both>done':{'role':'admin','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
cases=[
 ({'from':'missing','to':'done'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'secure','to':'done','role':'user','attempts':0}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'both','to':'done','role':'user','attempts':False}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'retry','to':'done'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'retry','to':'done','attempts':False}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'retry','to':'done','attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'retry','to':'done','attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'retry','to':'done','attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'retry','to':'done','attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'plain','to':'done','attempts':99}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'})]
for request, expected in cases:
    request_before=copy.deepcopy(request); policy_before=copy.deepcopy(policy)
    actual=evaluate(request, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (request, actual, expected)
    assert request == request_before and policy == policy_before
    assert list(actual) == ['ok','value','reason'] and set(actual) == {'ok','value','reason'}
print(json.dumps({'passed':len(cases)}))

import json
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
actual=[evaluate(request, policy) for request in requests]
assert actual == report, (actual, report)
assert all(set(item)=={'ok','value','reason'} for item in report)
print(json.dumps(actual))
